items.text: Survivor Cells has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

New Game Mode: Endless: Now you can test your limits in the new Endless mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.
Alchemy Improvements: The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!
Laboratory Enhancements: The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements: We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

New SFX: To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!: Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!: Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/

items.text: We are very happy with our game and would like to thank all players for the Feedbacks and Reviews!!!
Suggestions and reviews are very important to us!!!
Today we are happy to release a new update with improvements to the game and the new “Game Modes” section in it you will find “Speed Run – Find the Tower”.
To access the “Game Modes” section you must complete the adventure mode.
+ New mini game “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;
+ Exclusive ranking for “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;

In gratitude for the community feedback and in celebration of the 2nd game in the series, the Geometric Sniper Blood in Paris, which will be officially launched on 09/09/21, we are launching the mini game “Speed Run – Find the Tower” which will have its exclusive ranking .
To score points you'll have to find 12 towers one in each level in the shortest time possible!
Who will be the fastest Sniper?
The third game in the series is already in production and you can now add it to Wishlist and see a video, images and gifs on the game page!
We are very excited and happy with the development and community acceptance of the second game in the series “Geometric Sniper – Blood in Paris”!
The suggestions and reviews we received are being very important for the development of this second game in the series!!!
+ Two new missions in Adventure mode;
+ Two new missions in find mode;
+ Now you can use the controller to play;

+ Mercenary game mode: This game mode is released after completing the 6th mission, in it you can have fun with new challenges and get money to pay compensation to the family of the civilian that you have mistakenly killed during the missions in the modes (Adventure and Elite), by doing this the negative score will be removed and added to the scoreboard.
Again we would like to continue to rely on community support to make this game a great success, for this we have the feedback and suggestions from you!

To facilitate communication beyond the forum here at Steam we are happy to present our official discord, there you will be able to share all your ideas and feedbacks about the new game and will be aware of all the news in advance.
We hope you continue to have a lot of fun with the game it is being made with great care!!!
Do not forget to tell us what you think !!!

+ now mission 10 in find mode is released;

+ One Hand - Thanks to the suggestion of one of our players who has a special need, we are happy to implement the “One hand” in the game, where the player will be able to have fun in the game with only the mouse without the keyboard; this function is already active and available from the beginning for; and for those who have already got used to the space bar, do not worry it, this option is still avalible;

+ Replay Adventure mode - Another suggestion from our players: now after completing the adventure mode, all missions will be released so the player can replay as many times as he wants to improve his score, discover other locations of the target or discover another way to eliminate the target on the 1st, 8th and 10th mission without having to reset the game. Just go to the mission page and press play; the score will only be overwritten if you score higher than the one previously made.
